**Daily Market Summary · 16 November 2026**

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin is near $64,950, down about 13.7% over 7 days and about 20% over 30 days.
• Headline: **NEUTRAL** (medium confidence). Fear & Greed is 10, extreme fear.
• Price is about 4% under its 200-week average ($67,656) and about 11% under its 200-day average ($72,859).

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Bitcoin bounced a little after the weekend fall to about $62,000; no single cause is reported for the bounce.
• About $1.71B of bets on price moves were forced to close in 24 hours, mostly bets on a rise (PANews, CoinGlass data).
• About 12,600 BTC more moved onto exchanges than left them over 7 days (PANews, CoinGlass data).

**Short-term outlook (next 1-7 days)**
The mood is in deep fear and the next weeks now lean down. The medium-term reading entered its weak zone today; five days in a row there would turn the headline BEARISH.
• Turns up: a close above $67,656 (200-week average), next $72,859 (200-day average).
• Sideways: between $64,128 and $67,656; a normal week swings about $3,971.
• Turns down: a close below $64,128 (30-day low).
• Rally watch: drop window open since 11 November; a rally signal needs about $81,241.
• This week: Fed speeches, Nvidia results on 17 November; next Fed meeting 8 December.

**News that matters**
• About 13 EH/s of mining power was hijacked; Luxor confirmed a tool breach and promises compensation (PANews). Short term, negative.
• Miner MARA sold 13,597 bitcoin in six weeks and plans more sales (PANews). Medium term, negative.
• Goldman Sachs, Citi and 19 others commit about $270M to a joint dollar stablecoin for 2027 (PANews). Long term, positive.

**Altcoins & themes**
• Trading platforms under scrutiny: Aster says a sudden swing came from forced closes of heavily borrowed positions and is investigating (ASTER +2.0% in 24h, HYPE +4.1%).
• New on Reku: Midnight (NIGHT) is up about 27% in 7 days after its network upgrade added private transfers (PANews); the reports give no single reason for the move.

**Bigger picture**
The next month leans down; the 3-6 month picture still leans up only barely, and is back on track only above $72,859 (200-day average).

https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Paid:** hold trader-targeted spend and keep a reserve, because a Rally watch drop window is open and Bitcoin is under its 200-week average ($67,656). Do not raise trader spend until a close back above $72,859, and apply a d30 ROI stop-loss on running campaigns. Lean new-user ads on trust and learning (Fear & Greed is 10), and keep rally creatives ready in case Rally watch turns near $81,241.

**Social & content:** keep the normal rhythm with calm, factual posts. Bitcoin is down about 13.7% in a week. Explain the mining-machine hack plainly (about 13 EH/s hijacked, Luxor promises compensation, per PANews). Post a 'who is buying, who is selling' explainer on MARA's 13,597 BTC sale and Saylor's hint at new buying. Use the bank stablecoin venture (Goldman, Citi and 19 others) for a 'what is a stablecoin' post. No upbeat price posts.

**CRM:** no promotional pressure this week. Send active holders a calm market update with links to safety and how-it-works content, plus a security reminder (mining-machine hack, Coinone contractor breach, per PANews). Keep registered-but-not-depositing and dormant users on regular lifecycle messages only. Have the onboarding journey ready: new sign-ups tend to arrive 2-4 weeks after a rally.

**SEO:** Pluang is covering the drop live and Pintu is mostly posting daily stock and gold price pages; Indodax could not be read today. 1) Why Bitcoin fell and fund outflows (Pluang, Pintu): refresh 'why is Bitcoin down today' with plain reference levels. 2) Mining-machine hack (Pluang, 5+ posts): publish a plain explainer on what happened. 3) Strategy buying the dip (Pluang, Pintu): prepare a 'what is a Bitcoin treasury company' page in case Strategy discloses a purchase this week. Check each against Reku's pages. https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Altcoins:** trading platforms are under scrutiny. Aster's CEO says the token's sudden swing came from forced closes of heavily borrowed positions, possibly with malicious activity (ASTER +2.0% in 24h), and DFINITY's founder argues Hyperliquid works like a centralized exchange (HYPE +4.1%), per PANews. Banks are moving into stablecoins with a $270M joint venture. New on Reku: Midnight (NIGHT) is up about 27% in 7 days after a network upgrade added private transfers, with no single reason reported for the move. Babylon (BABY) holds its founders call today; the project says Aave voted to accept native Bitcoin as collateral through it.
